## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue, if any.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Distinguish live API/DB checks from
deterministic tests, and state what was skipped or remains unverified.

## Compatibility and release

State whether public APIs, package versions, documentation, or release metadata
changed. Infrastructure-only changes do not require a package version bump.

## Review

Record the Codex review outcome and any unresolved findings. Maintainers decide
when to merge; NuGet publication remains a separate manual action.
